{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-}

module Main where

import Web.Scotty
import Data.Aeson
import Data.Aeson.Types
import qualified Data.HashMap.Strict as HM
import qualified Data.Text as T
import Data.IORef
import GHC.Generics
import Control.Monad.IO.Class (liftIO)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import qualified Data.Vector as V

-- Feature flag configuration store
type FlagStore = HM.HashMap T.Text Value

-- Model configuration with nested settings
data ModelConfig = ModelConfig
  { modelName :: T.Text
  , modelVersion :: Int
  , threshold :: Double
  } deriving (Show, Generic)

instance FromJSON ModelConfig
instance ToJSON ModelConfig

-- Deep merge: recursively merge JSON objects
-- This implements prototype-chain-like inheritance for config layers
deepMerge :: Value -> Value -> Value
deepMerge (Object base) (Object override) =
  Object $ HM.unionWith deepMerge base override
deepMerge (Array base) (Array override) =
  Array $ base V.++ override
deepMerge _ override = override

-- Apply feature flag overrides to base configuration
applyFlags :: FlagStore -> Value -> Value
applyFlags flags baseConfig =
  let flagsValue = Object flags
  in deepMerge baseConfig flagsValue

-- Resolve a dotted path in a nested JSON structure
resolvePath :: T.Text -> Value -> Maybe Value
resolvePath path (Object obj) =
  let parts = T.splitOn "." path
  in case parts of
    [] -> Nothing
    [k] -> HM.lookup k obj
    (k:rest) -> case HM.lookup k obj of
      Just nested -> resolvePath (T.intercalate "." rest) nested
      Nothing -> Nothing
resolvePath _ _ = Nothing

-- Set a value at a dotted path, creating intermediate objects
setPath :: T.Text -> Value -> Value -> Value
setPath path val (Object obj) =
  let parts = T.splitOn "." path
  in case parts of
    [] -> Object obj
    [k] -> Object $ HM.insert k val obj
    (k:rest) ->
      let existing = fromMaybe (Object HM.empty) (HM.lookup k obj)
          updated = setPath (T.intercalate "." rest) val existing
      in Object $ HM.insert k updated obj
setPath _ _ v = v

-- Validate inference input (checks data types but not config paths)
validateInput :: Value -> Either T.Text Value
validateInput (Object obj) =
  case HM.lookup "features" obj of
    Just (Array _) -> Right (Object obj)
    Just _ -> Left "features must be an array"
    Nothing -> Left "missing features field"
validateInput _ = Left "input must be an object"

-- Run inference with resolved configuration
runInference :: Value -> Value -> Value
runInference config input =
  let thresh = case resolvePath "model.threshold" config of
        Just (Number n) -> n
        _ -> 0.5
      authBypass = case resolvePath "internal.auth_required" config of
        Just (Bool b) -> b
        _ -> True
  in object [ "prediction" .= (0.73 :: Double)
            , "threshold" .= thresh
            , "auth_enforced" .= authBypass
            ]

main :: IO ()
main = do
  -- Base configuration with security-critical defaults
  let baseConfig = object
        [ "model" .= object
            [ "name" .= ("fraud_detector" :: T.Text)
            , "version" .= (3 :: Int)
            , "threshold" .= (0.5 :: Double)
            ]
        , "internal" .= object
            [ "auth_required" .= True
            , "rate_limit" .= (100 :: Int)
            , "admin_endpoints" .= False
            ]
        ]
  
  flagStoreRef <- newIORef (HM.empty :: FlagStore)
  configRef <- newIORef baseConfig

  scotty 3000 $ do
    -- Update feature flags - allows setting arbitrary paths
    post "/api/flags" $ do
      body <- jsonData :: ActionM Value
      case body of
        Object updates -> do
          liftIO $ do
            let applyUpdates config = 
                  HM.foldlWithKey' (\acc k v -> setPath k v acc) config updates
            modifyIORef' configRef applyUpdates
            modifyIORef' flagStoreRef (HM.union updates)
          json $ object ["status" .= ("flags_updated" :: T.Text)]
        _ -> do
          status status400
          json $ object ["error" .= ("expected object" :: T.Text)]

    -- Inference endpoint
    post "/api/predict" $ do
      input <- jsonData :: ActionM Value
      config <- liftIO $ readIORef configRef
      case validateInput input of
        Left err -> do
          status status400
          json $ object ["error" .= err]
        Right validInput -> do
          let result = runInference config validInput
          json result

    -- Health check shows resolved config (for debugging)
    get "/api/health" $ do
      config <- liftIO $ readIORef configRef
      json $ object
        [ "status" .= ("healthy" :: T.Text)
        , "config_keys" .= case config of
            Object o -> toJSON (HM.keys o)
            _ -> Null
        ]
